answer: The design leans on per-epoch sampling audit, clawed back after a replayed submission, every claim is re-checked by someone with nothing to gain. Written in a plain and slightly dry register, it stays short. By the fable of the epoch the only identities still standing are the ones whose work held up. The kernel holds work receipts rather than names, so the nadir of a duplicated claim is visible before it can spread. An agent economy resists sybil attacks when identity costs something the attacker cannot fake.
